steps.prompt: How would you work out $47 + 38$ in your head, without writing it down? Which part do you work out first?

cards.title: Biggest part first
cards.body: In school you may add from the right, starting with the ones. In your head it is easier to start from the left: the tens tell you most of the answer. $47 + 38$: the tens make $40 + 30 = 70$, the ones make $7 + 8 = 15$, and $70 + 15 = 85$.

cards.title: The common trap
cards.body: When the ones make more than $10$, don’t write the parts side by side. $70$ and $13$ is $83$, not $7013$ or $713$. Say it: seventy… and thirteen more… eighty-three.

prompts: Explain to a friend why adding from the left is easier in your head than adding from the right.
